en: Namaste 🙏 Your puja/chadhava video is shared on your registered WhatsApp from {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}}. You can also open LifeGuru → Profile / booking summary: https://lifeguru.app/profile — guide: https://youtube.com/shorts/x_rNUVPZ76s
hi: Namaste 🙏 Puja/chadhava video aapke registered WhatsApp par {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} se bheja jata hai. LifeGuru app → Profile / booking summary par bhi dekh sakte hain: https://lifeguru.app/profile

en: Namaste 🙏 After puja completes, the recorded video is usually shared on your registered WhatsApp within 3–4 days (quality check at our end). Please confirm your puja date — if it’s been more than 5 days after that date, say “human agent” and we’ll check.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Puja complete hone ke baad video aam taur par 3–4 din mein registered WhatsApp par bheja jata hai. Agar puja date ke 5 din se zyada ho gaye hon to “human agent” likhein — hum check karenge.

en: After puja, the temple shares the recording the next day; we then verify puja details and Sankalp before sending — so up to 4 days is normal. Your video will be sent as soon as it’s ready 🙏
hi: Puja ke baad recording temple se aati hai; phir details verify karke bhejte hain — isliye 4 din tak lag sakta hai. Video ready hote hi bhej diya jayega 🙏

en: Please copy the video link and paste it in your browser. If it still fails, tell us — we can help further or connect you to the team.
hi: Video link copy karke browser mein paste karein. Phir bhi na khule to batayein — team madad kar sakti hai.

en: Namaste 🙏 Please check around 3–5 seconds into the video — name and gotra often appear in the Sankalp section. If still missing, share registered mobile or Order ID — say “human agent” to verify 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Video ke 3–5 second par dekhein — naam/gotra Sankalp mein aate hain. Phir bhi na ho to mobile/Order ID ke saath “human agent” likhein 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 We regret if gotra was not clear in the video. We can verify and, if needed, arrange re-performance in the next schedule at no extra cost. Say “human agent” with your Order ID 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Agar gotra video mein clear nahi tha to maafi — verify karke agle schedule par dubara puja bina extra charge ho sakti hai. Order ID ke saath “human agent” likhein 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 Sorry for the mispronunciation. We can arrange re-performance in the next schedule at no extra cost. Share correct name and gotra — say “human agent” 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Galat uccharan ke liye maafi. Agle schedule par dubara puja bina extra charge ke ho sakti hai. Sahi naam/gotra bhejein — “human agent” 🙏

en: Please wait for the recorded video (usually 3–4 days after puja). You can verify your name there. If it is still missing, we will help with a suitable resolution — say “human agent” 🙏
hi: Recording ka intezaar karein (3–4 din). Wahan naam verify karein. Na ho to “human agent” — upay karenge 🙏

en: Network glitches can make live chanting hard to hear. Your name and gotra are taken during puja — please verify in the recorded video when you receive it 🙏
hi: Live par network se naam kam sunai deta hai. Puja mein naam/gotra liya jata hai — recording mein verify karein 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 Personal wishes are often offered silently in tradition; the pandit reviews submitted wishes before puja and includes them in the rituals. If you are still unhappy, say “human agent” 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Manokamna aksar man hi arpit hoti hai; pandit puja se pehle wishes dekhte hain. Phir bhi issue ho to “human agent” 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 Pujas are at listed temples per Vedic rituals. Recording inside Garbh Griha is not permitted, so rituals happen in the authorized area on temple premises — not a different puja 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Puja listed mandir par hoti hai. Garbh Griha mein shoot allowed nahi — isliye authorized area mein recording hoti hai 🙏

en: Group puja mentions all devotees in collective Sankalp. Links are unlisted — only people with the link can view; your details are not published publicly 🙏
hi: Group puja mein sab ke naam Sankalp mein aate hain. Link unlisted hai — sirf link wale dekh sakte hain; public publish nahi hota 🙏

en: The link we share stays available; we still recommend downloading or saving to Google Drive for your records 🙏
hi: Link active rehti hai; phir bhi download/Drive par save karna behtar hai 🙏

en: Sample videos on the site are for illustration. Every live puja can differ in lighting, décor, or pandit — rituals follow Vedic procedure 🙏
hi: Website sample sirf example hai. Har live puja thodi alag dikhe — vidhi Vedic rehti hai 🙏

en: Please share your updated Sankalp or wish — if the booking window is still open, we can update it for the puja. Say “human agent” with the exact text you want included 🙏
hi: Updated sankalp/manokamna bhejein — booking window khuli ho to update ho sakta hai. Exact text ke saath “human agent” likhein 🙏

en: Your video is in our quality review queue and will be sent on registered WhatsApp within 3–4 days of the puja date 🙏
hi: Video review mein hai — puja date ke 3–4 din mein WhatsApp par bhej di jayegi 🙏
